catalog.title: NASA Exoplanet Archive Planetary Systems Composite Parameters nearby confirmed planets
catalog.query: select pl_name,hostname,pl_letter,gaia_dr2_id,gaia_dr3_id,hip_name,hd_name,tic_id,ra,dec,sy_dist,sy_disterr1,sy_disterr2,sy_vmag,sy_kmag,disc_year,discoverymethod,disc_facility,disc_telescope,pl_orbper,pl_orbpererr1,pl_orbpererr2,pl_orbsmax,pl_orbsmaxerr1,pl_orbsmaxerr2,pl_rade,pl_radeerr1,pl_radeerr2,pl_bmasse,pl_bmasseerr1,pl_bmasseerr2,pl_eqt,pl_eqterr1,pl_eqterr2,st_teff,st_tefferr1,st_tefferr2,st_spectype,st_lum,st_rad,st_mass from pscomppars where sy_dist is not null and ra is not null and dec is not null and sy_dist <= 20000
catalog.archivePaper: The NASA Exoplanet Archive: Data and Tools for Exoplanet Research

selection.predicate: sy_dist is not null and ra is not null and dec is not null and sy_dist <= 20000

provenance.credit: NASA Exoplanet Archive, operated by Caltech under contract with NASA's Exoplanet Exploration Program
provenance.usageBoundary: The archive aggregates published literature. Parameter-level literature references and any third-party rights remain with their originating sources.
